template.name: Elf Wizard Template
template.description: A scholarly spellcaster with keen intellect and magical heritage. Excellent for players who enjoy strategic thinking and versatile magic.

racial.name: Darkvision
racial.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

racial.name: Fey Ancestry
racial.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

racial.name: Trance
racial.description: You don't need to sleep and can't be forced to sleep. You meditate deeply for 4 hours and gain the same benefit as 8 hours of sleep.

racial.name: Keen Senses
racial.description: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

racial.name: Elf Weapon Training
racial.description: You have proficiency with longswords, shortbows, longbows, and shortbows.

racial.name: Cantrip
racial.description: You know one cantrip of your choice from the wizard spell list (Prestidigitation recommended).

racial.name: Extra Language
racial.description: You can speak, read, and write one extra language of your choice.

class.name: Spellcasting
class.description: You can cast wizard spells using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability.

class.name: Ritual Casting
class.description: You can cast wizard spells as rituals if they have the ritual tag and are in your spellbook.

class.name: Spellbook
class.description: Contains 6 1st-level spells of your choice. You add spells as you level up and can copy spells you find.

background.name: Researcher
background.description: When you attempt to learn information, you know where and from whom you can obtain it, usually from a library, university, or sage.

knownCantrips.name: Mage Hand
knownCantrips.description: Create a spectral floating hand that can manipulate objects.

knownCantrips.name: Minor Illusion
knownCantrips.description: Create a sound or image of an object for 1 minute.

knownCantrips.name: Prestidigitation
knownCantrips.description: Perform a minor magical trick (racial cantrip).

knownSpells.name: Magic Missile
knownSpells.description: Create 3 darts of magical force, each dealing 1d4+1 force damage.

knownSpells.name: Shield
knownSpells.description: Gain +5 AC and immunity to Magic Missile until start of your next turn.

knownSpells.name: Comprehend Languages
knownSpells.description: Understand any spoken language or read any written text.

knownSpells.name: Identify
knownSpells.description: Learn the properties of a magical item or spell affecting a creature.

knownSpells.name: Sleep
knownSpells.description: Put creatures to sleep in a 20-foot radius (5d8 hit points worth).

traits: I am horribly, horribly awkward in social situations.
I speak without really thinking through my words, invariably insulting others.
ideals: Knowledge: The path to power and self-improvement is through knowledge.
bonds: The workshop where I learned my trade is the most important place in the world to me.
flaws: I overlook obvious solutions in favor of complicated ones.

backstory.summary: A studious elf who spent years in academic research before taking up adventuring. Seeks to expand knowledge and discover lost magical secrets.
keyEvents: Spent decades studying in a magical academy
Mentored by a respected wizard who disappeared mysteriously
Discovered a fragment of an ancient spellbook
Left academic life to seek practical magical knowledge
Joined an adventuring party to explore dangerous ruins
connections: Other elves from the same community

level2.notes: Evocation Savant: Copy evocation spells for half cost and time

spells: Learn 2 new spells of any level you can cast
level3.recommendations: Web, Misty Step, or Scorching Ray for 2nd-level spells

level4.recommendations: Increase Intelligence to 18 or take Fey Touched feat

combat: Stay at maximum range and use cantrips for minor threats
Use Shield reaction to avoid attacks when possible
Magic Missile for guaranteed damage against low-HP enemies
Sleep spell can end encounters against weak groups
exploration: Cast ritual spells freely (Detect Magic, Identify, Comprehend Languages)
Use Investigation skill to understand magical phenomena
Arcana knowledge helps identify magical threats and opportunities
social: Research background provides access to information
May be socially awkward but intellectually valuable to the party
Can identify magical items and provide scholarly knowledge

personalityOptions.arrogantIntellectual: Believes intelligence trumps all other qualities
personalityOptions.anxiousBookworm: More comfortable with books than people
personalityOptions.ambitiousResearcher: Driven to make groundbreaking magical discoveries
